modules.scope: Resolve the measured oneTBB batch-level performance gap by auditing and, if proven, implementing same-Scheduler root-Fiber participation in synchronous bulk execution while preserving the admitted callback, error, cancellation, lifetime and complexity contract.
modules.non_goals: External-caller computation, cross-Scheduler worker borrowing, public partitioner or auto-grain policy, benchmark workload or peer changes, Graph/Compute/IO redesign, whole-scheduler rewrites, semantic weakening, Native FFI/C API, P2 claims and Formal certification.
known_limitations: The P1 engineering claim covers one frozen W1-WIN four-worker batch-structured source workload against pinned Marl and oneTBB revisions; it is not an all-operation, cross-platform, P2 inference-engine or Formal SOTA certificate.
The oneTBB and one Marl order exact-superiority verdicts remain INCONCLUSIVE even though every 5% non-inferiority gate passes; HYLE must not be described as universally faster than either runtime.

Root participation applies only when bulk_execute is called from a Fiber owned by the same Scheduler; external callers and cross-Scheduler Fibers do not compute, while worker-stack nested calls retain the serial progress-safe fallback.
Bulk bodies remain synchronous, non-suspending and borrowed until return; same-Scheduler root participation makes Fiber::current() and caller Fiber stack budget observable as documented.
Native FFI, a C API and a stable cross-toolchain C++ ABI are not promised; the vendored fcontext C and assembly boundary remains a private product mechanism.
reopen_triggers: A named consumer reproduces a correctness, security, cancellation, lifetime, stack-budget, API-usability or common scheduling-capability defect within the Sched boundary.
A public API or layout, bulk or ordinary scheduling algorithm, direct dependency, worker topology contract or source, static or shared delivery shape changes materially.
A mature same-contract peer proves a better complexity class or a reproducible material regression beyond the frozen 5% margin on a normal Sched consumer workload.
The performance contract, consumer provenance, peer revision, W1-WIN machine profile, instrument or retained evidence bundle changes while the engineering claim must be renewed.
A real inference-engine consumer admits adaptive partitioning, external-thread participation, suspending bulk bodies, heterogeneous execution or another currently excluded scheduling family.
